SELECT c.sort, a.cfg_device_id as cfgDeviceId, g.device_name as deviceName, IFNULL(b.record_time,"") as recordTime, IFNULL(b.mete_value,"") as state, a.camera_id as cameraId, f.camera_name as cameraName, a.preset_id as presetId, e.preset_name as presetName, h.instance_id as instanceId, i.analyse_type as analyseType FROM t_sequential_conf a left join t_cfg_data_current b on a.cfg_device_id = b.mete_id left join (SELECT (@i:=@i+1) as sort,x.cfg_device_id FROM t_sequential_conf x,(Select @i:=-1) z) c on a.cfg_device_id = c.cfg_device_id left join t_camera_preset e on a.preset_id = e.preset_id left join t_camera_info f on a.camera_id = f.camera_id left join t_cfg_device g on a.cfg_device_id = g.device_id left join t_cruise_point_instance h on h.cruise_id = a.preset_id left join t_std_devicemete i on i.device_mete_id = h.device_mete_id where 1=1 and c.cfg_device_id =#{cfgDeviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
